# Sweet Pepper (G4)

Sweet Pepper is a burgundy-coated Pegasus mare with a long burnt-orange mane and tail, pale blue eyes, and an unmistakable Daring Do convention outfit: a cream pith helmet and pale-green safari shirt. She is the delighted background cosplayer at the Manehattan Daring Do convention in *My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic*. She is **dressed as Daring Do**, not secretly Daring Do/A.K. Yearling.

[![Sweet Pepper in her Daring Do cosplay](https://camo.fimfiction.net/r5cPJ0l6N5RgGLsVcVE3F-DVTxcixDwNCT3YvVCwHpg?url=https%3A%2F%2Flh5.googleusercontent.com%2FR0U-_tbsiN1Oo_3odrGNEXw329ook0s9oSzP05tZ85c_g0d9XJ2nQKMvFJe_kpbxU-qCiU1pVX5qP1hsghUU_9AdmDSQzeo1GOe683NVzmu5H6zjCRyFsgmQ4FqH2Qnxp7SVIHrT)](https://www.fimfiction.net/blog/944094/the-sweetest-of-sweet-peppers-an-autobiography-by-a-ghost-writer)

*Image:* Recognizable fan vector displayed in a 2021 post by AuroraDawn. The post does not establish the vector's original artist; AuroraDawn's detailed biography is **fan fiction**, not established television backstory.

**Names and appearances.** “Sweet Pepper” is a fandom/character-catalog name; its original coining is unverified. The licensed Gameloft *My Little Pony* game calls the same pony **“Cheerful Fan”** and describes her fondness for her Daring Do-inspired helmet. Her verified television appearance is *Stranger Than Fan Fiction* (season 6, episode 13; July 30, 2016), where she is visible among the conventiongoers. See the [Pegasus character catalog](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Pegasus_ponies) and a [Gameloft convention-character promotional image](https://ponerpics.org/images/2029003). She has no verified dialogue or individual voice-actor credit.
